create_balanced_batch_sampler: create a BalancedBatchSampler to distribute atom-balanced batches across distributed training replicas
create_stateful_distributed_sampler: create a StatefulDistributedSampler to resume data sampling from a specific training iteration
run_balanced_partition: run the balanced partition algorithm to greedily distribute samples by size across partitions
review_balanced_batch_sampler_iter: review the BalancedBatchSampler iterator that gathers atom counts and rebalances batches across replicas
test_stateful_distributed_sampler_resume: test the StatefulDistributedSampler set_epoch_and_start_iteration method to resume from a checkpoint
